purpose: Local portfolio design experiment. No pushes, deploys, or modifications to the two existing portfolio checkouts.

baseline.contentCaveat: Current role and career metrics are supported by owner-maintained source, not independently audited. The shared content checkout is concurrently edited; read only.

direction.focalPoint: Collin as a product leader who builds: a short claim paired with one real product artifact.
hierarchy: Project decisions and scoped enterprise results
direction.typePosture: Keep Inter + Newsreader; warm editorial serif emphasis; honor saved 56/36/28 display direction, fluid bounds, 16px prose minimum, 1.5-1.65 body leading.
direction.surfacePosture: Warm ivory, charcoal ink, signature navy and restrained gold; fine rules, clear whitespace, large artifact surfaces; avoid generic repeated card walls and decorative gradients.
direction.motionPosture: User-triggered artifact transitions and active background inspired by Motion Primitives; 180-320ms transform/opacity, no auto-advance, no scroll hijack; static readable content without JS and under reduced motion.

applied: minimalism-and-swiss-style: high contrast grid and minimal decoration
News Editorial typography: existing Newsreader with sans
44px targets, reduced motion, reserved media space
uiUxProMax.rejected: Two full design-system searches produced unsuitable ecommerce/brutalist font recommendations; neither is persisted as an approved system. Targeted domain guidance is used instead.

references.motionImplementation: Native CSS/JS adaptations, not installed React components. Keep the existing static site and add no dependencies.

plan.title: A concise proposition with a real artifact
plan.change: Replace metric carousel with a compact editorial hero: name, Director of Product at Persado, under-20-word claim, one primary work action and a real PM Toolkit artifact. Put selected work immediately after hero.
plan.acceptance: At 1440px the hero contains under 90 visible words, a visible primary action above the fold, and a headline <=56px. At 390px the role and action remain readable, no horizontal overflow. No autoplay. (Artifact proof moved to Independent products — content rewrite, Oct 2026.)

plan.title: Make selected work tangible and navigable
plan.change: Use real PM Toolkit images and clearly illustrative BidPacket/Arclo workflow graphics. Show PM Toolkit, BidPacket, Arclo Pro and Loupe with accurate status, concise problem/decision, and functioning project/live links. Use user-driven artifact tabs for selected views with Motion Primitives-inspired transitions.
plan.acceptance: Every featured project has a shipped artifact/named outcome or explicit development status and valid destination. No dummy video controls, href='#', fabricated user/revenue metrics or unlabeled mock screenshots. Artifact tabs respond to click and arrow keys and expose selected state. Real product image present without JS.

plan.title: Current positioning and attributable proof
plan.change: Bring in source-supported Persado Director positioning, current responsibilities and historical Employ results. Keep Arclo Pro separate from its prospecting pipeline; update stale BidPacket status; avoid unverified financial-loss claims.
plan.acceptance: Current employer is Persado on the home, work and about pages; Employ role is historical; JazzHR spelling and LinkedIn slug match new profile. Revenue numbers name initiative, company and timeframe. BidPacket links to real sample and no longer claims its entire pipeline is unbuilt. All 6 routes load and existing deep dives remain accessible. (Case studies are independent products and do not name Persado.)

plan.title: One visual language and a reliable contact path
plan.change: Share navigation, readable type, warm surface palette, keyboard focus and footer across routes. Use direct email contact, LinkedIn, GitHub, and existing resume. Mobile menu closes on Escape/navigation and exposes state.
plan.acceptance: Every page exposes contact without footer scrolling. All visible interactive mobile targets >=44x44; visible focus indicator; one h1 and no skipped heading levels; no serious/critical axe issues. Mobile menu is keyboard usable and no hidden focusable links. Prose >=16px.

plan.title: Motion and responsive verification
plan.change: Remove homepage carousel/counter choreography, keep interactions immediate with short transform/opacity transitions; verify 6 routes at desktop/tablet/mobile plus 320px overflow, reduced motion and JS-disabled homepage.
plan.acceptance: 18/18 route/viewport captures succeed; 320px probe has no overflow; reduced motion has no looping or long animation; no failed local assets or browser errors; evidence and honest residuals saved. Original working trees remain unchanged by this experiment.
